text.autoconfig.f5ranger.title: F5 Ranger Configuration
text.autoconfig.f5ranger.option.cameraDi: The target distance for the third-person camera.
text.autoconfig.f5ranger.option.minDista: The closest the camera can get to the player.
text.autoconfig.f5ranger.option.maxDista: The furthest the camera can zoom out.
text.autoconfig.f5ranger.option.scrollSt: How much the distance changes per scroll click.
text.autoconfig.f5ranger.option.lerpSpee: How fast the camera catches up to the target distance (Lower is smoother).
text.autoconfig.f5ranger.option.smoothCa: Whether the camera should slide smoothly between distances.
text.autoconfig.f5ranger.option.noClip.@: [Required On Server] If enabled, the camera will pass through blocks instead of colliding with them.
text.autoconfig.f5ranger.option.disableS: If enabled, the custom distance logic will NOT apply to the front-facing (Second Person) view.
text.autoconfig.f5ranger.option.showUISl: If enabled, a slider to set the camera distance is added to the vanilla settings screen.
